$comment: Your active BOLD projects. The digest job re-reads this every run and
recomputes the countdown + status chip from `date`, so the only thing you
ever need to edit is this file (then redeploy, or push — Vercel rebuilds).
id    unique, stable slug. Changing it re-suggests the project's task.
title what shows in the timeline.
date  YYYY-MM-DD of the event / deadline. Omit or null if not set yet.
when  optional human date range; derived from `date` when omitted.
note  one line of context — what actually needs to happen next.
